description: A writer: has a harness write a project's new program, in the copy of the project it is handed, and hands back what the harness left. Named as an update's updateWith.

parameters.prompt?: string: what is asked of the new version — handed by the runner to whoever writes an update, as the four that follow are
parameters.program?: string: the program it is written from, whole (it is program.ts in the copy, too)
parameters.kept?: boolean: whether what is made beside the program, in the copy, is kept with it
parameters.types?: string: the API a program has, as its author is shown it
parameters.copy?: string: where the copy of the project is — the writer's workspace — for a run it asks for to be given it
parameters.harness?: string: the project that does the work, by its name among the user's (coding-harness) — the writer's own, said in its meta.json, as the three that follow are
parameters.model?: string: the model the harness is to ask, as provider/model — else the harness's own
parameters.turns?: number: how often the harness asks its model at most
parameters.seconds?: number: how long the harness may take — else its own project's time

returns.program?: string: the whole of the new program
returns.said?: string: what the harness said it did
returns.nothing?: string: why nothing was written, where it was run with nothing to write

input.prompt: A writer of updates: named where an update is asked for (updateWith).
